description: Copilot "Plain Text" card holding a ```markdown fence: its HTML eats the fences as inline-code delimiters and puts the lines' own escaped <div><span> markup inside one <code>. Pasted as Rich it lands as a garbled inline code run; "Fix broken code blocks" (not "Render code blocks", which must stay disabled for it) restores the fenced text as a code block.
